# Comprehensive Beta Testing Report: GHG Accounting Web Application

**Date & Time of Assessment:** September 22, 2026, 22:34 CET  
**Testing Environment:** Frontend (http://localhost:5173), Backend (http://localhost:5000), Chrome DevTools MCP (Port 9222)  
**Authenticated User:** Administrator (`a` / `a`) — Role: Sustainability Lead  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

A comprehensive, physical browser-based beta testing audit was conducted across the entire GHG Accounting web platform. The system demonstrated exceptional computational precision, end-to-end data synchronization, robust adherence to international GHG reporting frameworks (IPCC AR4/AR5/AR6, GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, ISO 14064-1, EU CBAM, and OGMP 2.0), and immediate tamper-evident audit logging. 

Key functional workflows—including multi-scope emissions calculation, live equation validation, custom factor engineering with SRSS uncertainty calculation, SBTi 1.5°C net-zero trajectory modeling, satellite methane observation overlays (Copernicus Sentinel-5P), and ISO 14064-1 PDF/Excel report generation—were executed end-to-end. Several minor UI/UX anomalies, a duplicate component bug in Scope 3, and pagination edge cases were identified and documented for optimization.

---

## 2. In-Depth Testing Findings by Functional Area

### 2.1 Authentication & Session Management (`/login`)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Observations:**
  - Login form requires username/email and password with proper validation.
  - Successfully authenticated using administrative credentials (`a` / `a`).
  - Session state persists cleanly across client navigations. User profile dropdown provides role display ("Administrator - Sustainability Lead") and operational Sign Out capability.

### 2.2 Dashboard (`/`)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Key Metrics & Charts:**
  - Gross Operational Emissions (Scope 1+2): Verified at 10.2K tCO₂e (GWP-100).
  - Total Methane (CH₄): 338.9 tCH₄.
  - Production Performance Intensity: 0.04 kg CO₂e / BOE.
  - Live Content updates and category breakdown (Combustion: 191.5 t, Flaring: 210.2 t, Venting: 6.7K t, Other: 3.0K t).
  - **Dynamic GWP Horizon Toggle:** Toggling from GWP-100 to GWP-20 dynamically recalculated Gross Operational Emissions instantly from 10.2K tCO₂e to 29.2K tCO₂e and Performance Intensity from 0.04 kg/BOE to 0.11 kg/BOE without page reloads.
  - **Executive Brief PDF Export:** Successfully initiated and generated client-side executive brief without errors (`[Report] Raw emissions fetched: 23 records`).
  - **Theme Support:** No dark/light mode toggle was detected in the UI or HTML attributes.

### 2.3 Emissions & Scope Management (`/emissions`)
- **Scope 1 (Direct Emissions):**
  - **Cascading Facility Auto-Fill:** Selecting facility "Complexe Sidérurgique DRI/EAF (Tosyali)" automatically auto-populated Activity ("Steel & Iron (Acier DRI)"), Division ("Metallurgy"), and Field ("Industrial Zone").
  - **Unit Engineering Conversion:** Entering 1,000 m³ of Natural Gas was converted to 35,314.70 scf in accordance with standard gas volume conventions.
  - **Live Equation Inspector:** Tier 2/3 GHG Protocol calculation formula and AR6 GWP factors rendered dynamically in real time.
  - **Submission & Persistence:** Form submitted cleanly; record `s1_24` (1.913 tCO₂e) was written to the database with uncertainty bounds (CO₂ ±6%, CH₄ ±11%, N₂O ±11%, Combined 95% CI ±22%).
- **Scope 2 (Indirect Energy):**
  - **Execution:** Successfully calculated purchased electricity for Algerian National Grid at 100,000 kWh, producing exactly 52.200 tCO₂e.
  - **Modal Feedback:** Calculation result modal presented complete gas breakdown (52.20 t CO₂, 0.00 t CH₄/N₂O). Record `s2_1` saved as "Verified".
- **Scope 3 (Value Chain):**
  - **Execution:** Category 11 (Use of Sold Products - Crude Oil) calculated 500.00 bbl × 433.70 kg CO₂e/bbl = 216.850 tCO₂e with ±21.9% 95% CI. Record `s3_1` stored in verified state.
  - **Identified Bug (Duplicate Component):** In `Scope3Form.jsx`, the "EEIO Quick Spend Calculator" accordion is duplicated and rendered twice on the page (lines 433–445 and lines 619–631).
  - **Identified Edge Case (Pagination):** When tables have 0 rows (prior to data insertion), pagination displays "Page 1 of 0".

### 2.4 Carbon & Methane Intensity Analytics
- **Carbon Intensity (`/carbon-intensity`):**
  - Verified average GHG intensity (0.04 kg CO₂e/BOE), combined production (259.85M BOE), and flaring intensity.
  - **EU CBAM Product Specific Embedded Emissions:** Verified table with EU CN Codes (2711 11 00 LNG, 2523 10 00 Grey Portland Clinker, 3102 10 10 Urea, 7213 10 00 Hot Rolled Bars) calculating direct and indirect intensity alongside total embedded emissions.
  - Recharts visual representations (GHG Intensity by Facility, BOE contribution, 5-year historical trends) rendered with smooth SVG transitions and Heatmap toggle support.
- **Methane Intensity (`/methane-intensity`):**
  - Methane Loss Rate verified at 0.002% (comfortably compliant with OGMP 2.0 targets of ≤0.20% Upstream / ≤0.05% Midstream).
  - EPA WEC Liability calculated at $0 USD under IRA §136.
  - **OGMP 2.0 Roadmap:** Visualized multi-year Gold Standard pathway from Level 1/2 Segment up to Level 5 Site-Level Reconciliation across 43 facilities.
  - **Workbook Export:** "Export OGMP 2.0 (Excel)" generated the standardized 5-tab disclosure workbook (.xlsx) on demand.

### 2.5 SBTi & Net-Zero Trajectory (`/sbti`)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Workflow Tested:**
  - Clicked "Configure Target" modal.
  - Tested "Auto-Fill Verified" feature: automatically extracted verified database emissions for Base Year 2026 totaling 10,452.8 tCO₂e across all scopes.
  - Successfully configured and saved 1.5°C Corporate Net-Zero pathway through 2050 (4.2% linear annual reduction, capped at 10% residual emissions per NZ-C1).
  - Decarbonization pathway chart, stacked scope breakdown, and annual milestone verification table rendered immediately.

### 2.6 Data Ingestion & Manage Data (`/manage-data`)
- **Bulk Import Wizard:** Tested modal workflow with CSV template generation and download.
- **Custom Emission Factors:**
  - Created specialized factor: `High Efficiency Flare - Test EF`.
  - Tested **EF Uncertainty Workbench (ISO 14064-1 compliant)**: Entered Meter Precision (5%) and Lab Analysis (2%); executed Root-Sum-Square (SRSS) calculation yielding combined uncertainties of CO₂ ±5.39%, CH₄ ±50.25%, N₂O ±150.08%.
  - Saved factor to database; factor immediately appeared in the table and synced live with the global Reference Data Library.

### 2.7 Reports & Regulatory Disclosures (`/reports`)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Execution:**
  - Selected all 43 facilities using the MultiSelect dropdown chip component.
  - Initiated "Create Report" opening the **ISO 14064-1 Report Configuration Modal**.
  - Configured significance exclusion criteria (<1% threshold) and external verification declaration.
  - Executed PDF report generation; backend cleanly pulled all 26 verified records across Scopes 1, 2, and 3 without errors.

### 2.8 Audit Trail, QA/QC & Reference Libraries
- **Audit Trail (`/audit-trail`):**
  - Verified 239 immutable compliance events logged with microsecond precision.
  - Confirmed immediate real-time logging of all test actions (custom factor creation, Scope 3 submission, Scope 1 calculation) with IP address (`127.0.0.1`), user (`Administrator`), and collapsible raw JSON technical payload.
- **QA/QC & Diagnostics (`/qa-dashboard`):**
  - Data Health Score: 92/100 (Completeness: 96.9%).
  - IPCC Tier 1 Uncertainty: Combined ±5.33% (Scope 1: ±5.5%, Scope 2: ±2.7%, Scope 3: ±11.2%).
  - Zero anomalies detected; verified audit-readiness.
- **Emissions Map (`/methane-explorer`):**
  - Leaflet-powered GIS dashboard loaded 39 monitored assets with Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI satellite layer, SWIR Band 7/8 spectral legend, plume footprints, and opacity slider.
- **Reference Data Library (`/reference-data`):**
  - Verified cataloging of 15 gaseous fuels, 8 liquid fuels, 5 solid fuels, 44 equipment fugitive factors, GWPs, and instant inclusion of our newly generated custom factor under "Custom & Regional Factors".

---

## 3. Detailed Bug & Optimization Log

| Issue # | Severity | Component / Path | Description | Recommended Remediation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **BUG-01** | Medium | `Scope3Form.jsx` (L433 & L619) | The "EEIO Quick Spend Calculator" accordion is rendered twice consecutively on the Scope 3 page. | Remove the duplicate JSX block at line 619. |
| **BUG-02** | Low | Scope 2 & Scope 3 Tables | Pagination displays "Page 1 of 0" when the dataset contains zero records prior to submission. | Normalize pagination logic: `Math.max(1, totalPages)` or display `Page 0 of 0`. |
| **UX-01** | Low | Global / Top Navigation | Dark/Light mode toggle is not present in the header/navigation despite standard design system tokens. | Implement a theme toggle in the header connecting to `data-theme="dark"` / CSS variables. |
| **A11Y-01** | Low | Forms (Scope 1, 2, Reports) | Browser console logs `No label associated with a form field` and missing `id`/`name` attributes on select custom inputs. | Add `aria-label`, `htmlFor`, and `id` tags to all form controls to ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. |

---

## 4. Overall Assessment

- **Stability & Performance:** Excellent. Zero backend crashes (500) or client-side fatal runtime errors occurred during intensive multi-module testing.
- **Scientific & Regulatory Rigor:** Outstanding. Unit conversions, GWP dynamic toggling (AR5 vs AR6 vs AR4; 100-yr vs 20-yr), SRSS uncertainty compounding, and ISO 14064-1 compliance validations match industry standards.
- **Release Readiness:** **Ready for Staging / Candidate for Release (RC1)** with resolution of the duplicate Scope 3 component (BUG-01).

*Note: The physical browser recording and telemetry artifacts are preserved in the session artifact store.*
